items.question: Why scrape Xiaohongshu comments instead of reading manually?
items.answer: Manual review misses scale and patterns. A scraper helps you collect large, structured datasets so you can quickly identify recurring pain points, objections, and buying intent.

items.question: How do I scrape comments from a Xiaohongshu post?
items.answer: Install MediaClaw, open a Xiaohongshu post in desktop browser, and start comment scraping. The tool auto-scrolls and captures comment fields, then exports data in one click.

items.question: Is this Xiaohongshu comment scraper free?
items.answer: Yes. Core scraping and export workflows are available for free, making it practical for daily content research and competitor monitoring.

items.question: How many comments should I export for analysis?
items.answer: For most projects, 200-500 recent or high-engagement comments provide enough signal for trend analysis. More data helps, but quality sampling usually matters more than volume.

items.question: What can teams do with exported comment data?
items.answer: Teams can run sentiment analysis, identify product feedback trends, validate content angles, and build lead qualification rules from real audience language.

items.question: Can I sync comment data to Lark Base for collaboration?
items.answer: Yes. You can push exported data into Lark Base to assign tasks, tag insights, and keep your research-to-action workflow in one shared workspace.
